spec_features.spec_quote: A `max_turns` cap; the run ends on `finish`, on a text-only reply, or at the cap
spec_features.evidence: subject/loop.py: LoopConfig.max_turns=12 (line ~60); loop `for _step in range(cfg.max_turns)` enforces the cap. On `finish` tool call: `run.stop_reason='finished'; finished=True; break`. On text-only reply (`if not resp.tool_calls:`): `run.stop_reason='text_only'; finished=True; break`. When loop exhausts without finishing: `if not finished: run.hit_turn_limit=True; run.stop_reason=run.stop_reason or 'turn_limit'`. All three exit paths actually run and stop the loop.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end: the range() bounds iterations and both break conditions are real. `finish` is dispatched (tools.py:112) and honored as the stop. This is the only mechanism that bounds the subject's exposure.
